journal.summary: Selected the lightest bounded path: preserve the existing dirty baselines, reproduce only named gates, inventory before adapters, and defer OAuth, deployment, and broad best-in-class refinements.
Wave 0 passed: Trio driver contracts 189/194 with five explicit live skips, Jumper 42/42, and the user-global preference mirror hash remained unchanged.

Wave 1 inventory froze 12 canonical Foundry surfaces: five clean shared-Trio routes, one shared route with a telemetry gap, four prompt-only or deterministic surfaces, and two missing adapters; selected Ecgberht as the first isolated adapter gate.
Ecgberht shared-Trio subgate passed 46 focused assertions with no live call or preference mutation; ChatGPT frontier requests Ultra and all four families share one receipt-bearing production seam.
The host PowerShell did not support Get-Date -AsUTC; used the single built-in ToUniversalTime() equivalent, with no task or filesystem impact.
Tidy-Idy shared-Trio subgate passed 40 focused assertions; production model roles now follow Anchor preferences through Trio, receipts are retained, and the legacy fixture remains hermetic.
Literature Review truth subgate passed 31 focused assertions; lineage and cross-model/model training telemetry now derive from actual Trio receipts rather than hard-coded Gemini/Claude claims.

Ramanujan's initial missing-adapter label was corrected after a 64-assertion boundary gate: the canonical skill is host-routed, the CLI is deterministic, and Phase F is a specialized evidence appliance whose pinned verifier identities cannot be swapped through Trio without redefining its certificate contract.

Wave 1 accepted: every canonical model surface now uses shared Trio or has an explicit host-routed/deterministic/specialized-external disposition; no general adapter remains missing, no live model ran, and reviewer/judge attestation remains fail-closed.

Wave 2 inspection found three visible model controls instead of four: Judge is absent, and ChatGPT appears selectable for Terminal despite the persistent interactive bridge being fail-closed. Selected one shared four-role capability matrix while keeping Judge linked to review_family under the universal seating law.

The first multi-file apply_patch matched a mojibake rendering of an em dash instead of the UTF-8 source and was rejected atomically; no file changed. Re-read the source explicitly as UTF-8 and split the edit into smaller verified patches.

The new browser smoke initially failed before page launch because the existing ChatGPT fixture redirects LOCALAPPDATA to a synthetic Codex directory, which also redirected Playwright's browser lookup. No application assertion ran; preserve the fixture's transport isolation but restore the captured host LOCALAPPDATA only for the Playwright launch.

The browser then reached the page but Playwright's locator.is_disabled() did not report an OPTION element's disabled DOM property. Static output already proved the attribute; changed the browser assertion to read option.disabled directly, without changing application behavior.

Wave 2 accepted: four explicit role selectors share one honest capability matrix, Judge remains linked to review_family, the combined synthetic API/home/branding/browser gate passed 89/89, and the real preference mirror was unchanged.

Wave 3 inspection found the existing slice structurally aligned: plain project URLs serve the current cockpit, __dashboard__ does the same, classic remains an explicit escape, and Calendar/Email are marked empty synthetic with a local-only Gmail/Outlook preview. No rewrite selected pending the fresh gate and served-static identity scan.

A combined read-only inspection used the unsupported PowerShell || separator and stopped before all requested reads. Reissuing the same bounded checks with native if/LASTEXITCODE branching; no file or external state changed.

Wave 3 accepted without another product edit: the fresh default/classic route, synthetic-state, local-only provider-dialog, browser, and deny-by-default distribution gate passed 9/9; the real preference mirror remained unchanged.

Wave 3 stopped at its required acceptance boundary and the controller had no active test or background process until Wave 4 was explicitly resumed. The user nevertheless saw no visible continuation/status for several hours; Wave 4 is now active and the inventory artifact is the first gate.

Wave 4 will not infer ownership from the heavily dirty repositories: it will inventory the bounded run files separately from pre-existing changes, run named deterministic gates only, and prepare a Fable request without invoking a model or release action.

A package-script inspection assumed Tidy-Idy had its own package.json; that read reported path-not-found while the adjacent Literature package read succeeded. Tidy's full gate will use node --test test directly; no file or process state changed.

The first Wave 4 Trio rerun invoked node --test on a directory, which Node 26 treated as a missing module; no test file ran and Jumper was intentionally not started after that nonzero exit. Reissuing Trio with its package-script quoted test glob, then Jumper separately; preferences were unchanged.

The Ecgberht full-suite command exceeded the 30-second yield, but the wrapper printed only output and omitted the returned session id, so the still-running test cannot be polled through its PTY. Process inspection confirms the npm/run-all-tests tree is alive; it will be allowed to finish, and future long commands will print/store their session id.

Before the Ecgberht full-suite output yielded, it exposed at least one failing assertion: S1-E1 titlebar seal/steward/seat/stamp. The run continues; that exact test will be rerun in isolation and compared with HEAD/current overlap before any fix is considered.

The Ecgberht process completed and the isolated 30-case seal-chamber contract confirmed exactly one stale assertion: it expected three titlebar families after the formal ChatGPT adapter intentionally made the family list four. The test now asserts the exact ordered family set chatgpt/claude/gemini/grok; the isolated contract passes 30/30.

The post-correction complete Ecgberht harness returned exit 1 even though the retained tail showed the auth lane at 125/125 and the Python bridge at 30/30. The oversized skill-lane output was truncated, so the remaining failure is not yet honestly identified; rerun the harness as separate skill and auth lanes with failure-only capture.

The failure-only Ecgberht skill lane passed 1156/1161 and isolated all five failures to the pre-existing WH4 conversational-kickoff acceptance surface. Its prompt-bound August 6 real-seat replay no longer matches the current dirty kickoff/synthesis prompt. Rebinding old model output to new prompt hashes would falsify the anti-drift evidence, while a genuine refresh requires a live model call forbidden by this wave; keep the full gate visibly blocked and continue independent bounded gates.
Tidy-Idy's complete deterministic suite passed 494 runnable tests with one explicit host-capability skip and zero failures; the model-preference mirror hash remained unchanged.
Literature Review's complete deterministic suite passed 934/934 with zero skips and zero failures; the model-preference mirror hash remained unchanged.
Ramanujan's four-file capability-boundary gate passed 64/64 with both real-tool lanes explicitly disabled; no subscription model or network endpoint ran, and the preference mirror remained unchanged.

The bounded Anchor selector/capability/settings/ChatGPT-adapter/home/cockpit/connections/branding/distribution matrix passed 378 runnable tests with two explicit Windows capability skips and zero failures in 231.94 seconds; Python and connection-controller syntax passed, and the preference mirror remained unchanged.

Wave 4 evidence, handoff, and a read-only Fable adversarial-review request are prepared. Wave 4 stops BLOCKED at its acceptance gate because refreshing the five prompt-bound WH4 replay cases requires a live model call not authorized for this wave; no Fable or release action was invoked.

next_action: Request explicit authority for one genuine live Steward fixture refresh, then rerun WH4 and the complete Ecgberht gate. Invoke the prepared read-only Fable review only after that gate is green or the blocker is explicitly accepted.
